neutral_capabilities.title: Snippet or gist
neutral_capabilities.description: Provider-native short-form content resource outside the repository tree.

neutral_capabilities.title: Hosted repository container
neutral_capabilities.description: Provider-hosted repository lifecycle and governance container. Git object and ref operations remain native git.

neutral_capabilities.title: Repository content
neutral_capabilities.description: Read and mutate repository tree content through native git or a provider contents API. The contract resolves authority and interaction mode; it does not model git objects or commands.

neutral_capabilities.title: Workflow or pipeline definition
neutral_capabilities.description: Provider-hosted automation definition that may be dispatched into a run.

neutral_capabilities.title: Workflow or pipeline run
neutral_capabilities.description: One provider-hosted automation execution and its observable result.

neutral_capabilities.title: Automation runner
neutral_capabilities.description: Execution capacity registered with the forge automation system.

neutral_capabilities.title: Commit status
neutral_capabilities.description: Provider-native status associated with a source revision.

neutral_capabilities.title: Structured revision check
neutral_capabilities.description: Rich check result with annotations and lifecycle distinct from a commit status.

neutral_capabilities.title: Package
neutral_capabilities.description: Package or container artifact hosted by the provider.

neutral_capabilities.title: Wiki
neutral_capabilities.description: Forge-hosted documentation collection associated with a repository or project.

neutral_capabilities.title: Deployment environment
neutral_capabilities.description: Named environment and its deployment governance controls.

neutral_capabilities.title: Provider event subscription
neutral_capabilities.description: Provider-side configuration that routes selected forge events to a callback or other delivery mechanism.
